pass_a_gloss: On angelic orders: they are rational ministers of God, not gods.
pass_b_english: On the end: God will be [[all in all >> Bible:1 Corinthians 15:28]]; the healing of rational creatures is hoped under providence, without making evil eternal as a rival principle. Corporeal and incorporeal are distinguished carefully; angels are rational ministers, not a second god. BOOK I CLOSEOUT.
